faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AETHER Vision.
faq.q1: Can I wear them with prescription lenses?
faq.a1: Yes. When ordering, you can input your prescription details. Our lenses are custom-manufactured to seamlessly integrate your prescription with the waveguide AR displays.
faq.q2: How long does the battery actually last?
faq.a2: For continuous heavy AR usage (navigation, video recording, active translation), expect 4-6 hours. For typical mixed usage (notifications, quick queries, periodic navigation), the battery easily lasts a full 16-hour day.
faq.q3: Does it require a smartphone to work?
faq.a3: AETHER Vision can function standalone for core features thanks to the built-in N2 chip and cellular option. However, pairing it with our iOS or Android app unlocks deeper integration with your existing notifications and ecosystem.
faq.q4: Is my data private and secure?
faq.a4: Privacy is our foundational principle. 100% of AI processing happens on-device. The camera does not record without an explicit physical button press, accompanied by an unavoidable bright LED indicator.
faq.a5: Wave 1 pre-orders will begin shipping in Q1. Due to high demand, new reservations will likely be allocated to Wave 2, slated for late Q2.
